assets.name: ascension-wings
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture for a classic Warcraft III fantasy tower-defense ascension attachment. Create ONE beautiful pair of symmetrical angelic magical feather wings viewed straight-on from behind, fully spread in a graceful high V, isolated on true transparent background. Wings only: no person, no body, no head, no circle, no text, no logo, no background. Left and right wing meet at a small central root at the lower middle, most wing area extends upwards and sideways. Elegant ivory feathers with antique-gold quills and subtle pale-cyan luminous edges, restrained highlights, dark defined feather separations, painterly chunky shapes readable from an RTS camera. 8 to 10 distinct large layered feathers per side, substantial silhouette not wispy light. Entire pair fits inside the square canvas with 8 percent transparent margin. Flat orthographic texture intended for alpha-blended two-sided wing mesh; no cast shadow, no perspective, no excessive bloom.
